entries.claim: Historical English basis of the Gospel (Luke 2:1–14), revised against the Latin in contemporary language: there went forth for There went out; This first enrollment was made by for This enrolling was first made by; Joseph also went up, In the same country there were shepherds and The Angel said without their opening And; betrothed for espoused; While they were there, the days for And it came to pass, that when they were there, her days; her firstborn Son, wrapped Him for her first-born son and wrapped him up; Do not be afraid for Fear not; tidings of great joy for good tidings of great joy; will for the predictive shall; to for unto; the heavenly host for the heavenly army; Caesar and Savior in the corpus spelling; the capitals of the Son, the Infant and the Angel; and the contemporary punctuation.
